## Description

In a few natural sentences, explain what changed, why, and the result. Keep it brief enough to understand the scope before reading the details below.

## Related issue

Closes #<issue-number>

## Changes

- <important change>

## Before / After (optional)

When a change benefits from comparison, show the prior behavior and the observed result after the change. Use a concise reproduction, UI state, or relevant command/test output; label anything not verified.

## Verification

List what was actually run or manually verified, with the result. Do not list checks that were not run.

- `<command>` — <passed / failed, with brief result>
- <manual verification>

## Merge risk (optional)

For changes with meaningful blast radius or difficult rollback, summarize the main risk and the mitigation or recovery path. Omit this for routine, low-risk changes.

## Decisions (optional)

Record only material implementation decisions, limitations, or tradeoffs a reviewer needs to know. Delete this section when unnecessary.
